content.text: The failing assertion is in the acceptance test I wrote last round, not in the source. It assumed `list` hides completed items by default. The existing spec (`src/commands.test.ts`) says the opposite: `list(todos)` shows everything, and only `{ includeDone: false }` hides finished items. A field rename shouldn't change behaviour, so I'm fixing my test to match the existing behaviour.
